dedupe_keys.name: fannysarrazin np point sources model v1 0

description: The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research publishes NP_point_sources_model, a Python model for nitrogen and phosphorus emissions from wastewater. Functions estimate domestic gross emissions from protein supply, determine the fate of domestic loads, calculate industrial and commercial loads entering sewers, and aggregate the results. A second module disaggregates emissions from statistical regions to a grid. Required inputs include urban and rural population, protein supply, detergent use and sewer-connection information. The repository supplies a Germany example and links its input dataset. GitHub and the archived version 1.0 on Zenodo provide source code openly and free under GPL-3.0. The equations can be applied where suitable regional inputs exist, but the documented example concerns Germany and does not demonstrate accuracy elsewhere. Code was inspected through its README and repository metadata, not executed. It could generate source terms for wastewater and receiving-water simulations. This process model complements the plant locations in data-hydrowaste; users must supply compatible regional statistics and check the separate licence of calibration data.
